description: Run the ScamSpecter Node test suite whenever a JavaScript file is saved, so a broken rule is caught immediately.
name: run-tests-on-save
note: This is a Kiro hook definition. It runs inside Kiro IDE / Kiro CLI when the project is open there. It was authored as part of the spec-driven workflow; it has not been executed by Kiro in this build environment because Kiro's agentic features require the entrant's own AWS Builder ID sign-in.
